client.title: Shopware Frontends API client
client.description: Shopware Frontends client: @shopware/api-client, api-gen types, composables, session and context tokens. Use when the request names the Shopware api-client, api-gen or a composable.
client.intro: The data layer. api-gen turns the shop's OpenAPI into types, so the client is typed against your actual shop.

practice.title: Shopware Frontends practice
practice.description: Shopware Frontends practice: best practices, worked examples, third-party integrations, deployment. Use when deploying a Shopware Frontends storefront or looking for an example.
practice.intro: Guidance and examples rather than API surface.
